output_list.criticism: In this contract, function 'win()' allows any user to transfer the round pot to the current greedy man. The winner is determined by 'luckyBuy()'. If it returns 'true', a random greedy man is chosen for the next round. The greedy man with the most hearts can't prevent other greedy men from buying more hearts in the round. The owner should be able to manage the rounds and the winner. The greediness of greedy man can't be manipulated by him. Function is subject to: Access Control
